 The Detroit Red Wings enter tonight's matchup at the Florida Panthers, losers of four straight games, dropping their overall record to 7-9-3. But their last win? A 5-3 win in this same building over the Panthers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Florida is still looking for some consistency of its own, dropping three of its last five games overall and now sits at 10-7-2 overall.
 In that Nov. 2 meeting the Red Wings outshot the Panthers 29-26 and if they want to halt their losing skid, they'll need to replicate that effort. One player who stepped up in that game was Red Wings defenseman Justin Faulk . He scored a goal and an assist in that game, and he'll have a chance to keep peppering the net tonight.
 The Panthers allow the 13th-most shots on goal per game to opposing defenseman. Faulk's shots on goal prop is on the board at 1.5 with the Over at +130 .
 Our PRO Props have Faulk projected at 1.61 shots on goal againts the Panthers, giving us a 5.3% edge on the market. Faulk's gone Over that number in two straight games and at this price is a solid value.
